title: Comunicado 2026-08-06
summary: Banxico held the overnight rate at 6.50% for a second meeting by a unanimous 5-0 vote and repeated the guidance that it will be appropriate to keep the rate at its current level, judging the stance adequate for the macro environment. Versus the 25 June communique the policy message is unchanged: a firm, unanimous hold with no easing bias. Current inflation improved (headline down to 3.10%, core back below 4%) and year-end 2026 expectations fell, but the forecast now has disinflation proceeding more gradually than previously expected, with headline convergence pushed later to Q4 2027 and core forecasts nudged up for early 2027. With longer-term expectations still above target and the balance of risks tilted to the upside, the slack and downside risks to activity are acknowledged but not used to open the door to cuts: a comfortable hold with upside-risk emphasis, no more dovish or hawkish than in June.

key_quotes.quote: Así, con la presencia de todos sus miembros, decidió por unanimidad mantener el objetivo para la Tasa de Interés Interbancaria a un día en 6.50%.
Hacia delante, la Junta de Gobierno considera que será apropiado mantener la tasa de referencia en su nivel actual.
key_quotes.context: Hold guidance repeated from June; no easing bias

key_quotes.quote: se sigue anticipando que las inflaciones general y subyacente desciendan a lo largo del horizonte de pronóstico, si bien de manera más gradual que lo anteriormente previsto.
key_quotes.context: Forecast revision: slower disinflation, convergence pushed to Q4 2027

key_quotes.quote: Se considera que el balance de riesgos respecto de la trayectoria prevista para la inflación en el horizonte de pronóstico mantiene un sesgo al alza.
key_quotes.context: Upside-tilted risk balance keeps the Board on hold despite lower current inflation
